idea-plugin.name: DotVVM
idea-plugin.description: DotVVM support for JetBrains Rider — syntax highlighting, navigation and validation for .dothtml, .dotmaster and .dotcontrol files.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.0

  • Live validation: the errors a build would report now show while editing - a mistyped property in a binding, an identifier the data context does not have, a value of the wrong type. The messages come from DotVVM's own view compiler
  • Saving compiles at once; typing waits half a second for the keystrokes to stop
  • Needs a project built on DotVVM 4.3.0 or newer; set DOTVVM_LS_LIVE_VALIDATION=off to switch it off

0.2.1

  • Completion offers the property families - Class-, Style-, Param- - on controls and on plain HTML elements alike
  • Cmd-click on a control tag opens the .dotcontrol file registered for it, or the class declaring it
  • A control read from the serialized configuration no longer loses what it inherits

0.2.0

  • Completion of a control's properties and of a directive's value - the view model type, a namespace, the path to a master page
  • Validation of the file header: a repeated or misspelt directive, a missing value, a type or master page that is not there
  • Server-side comments <%-- --%> are painted, parsed and produced as comments, between a tag's attributes as well
  • Cmd-click in a directive opens the type's source, or the project building the assembly named after the comma
  • Hover reports the properties of the project's own controls, markup controls included

0.1.0

  • Highlighting for binding expressions, including nested braces and quotes inside the expression
  • Directives: highlighting, name completion, navigation to the master page
  • Tag validation, control completion and navigation to the view model from the directive
  • A status bar indicator naming what the language server knows about the project
  • Suppression of messages the platform reports only because it does not know DotVVM
